expectations.text: Does not recommend photography or layout work the 12-day window cannot absorb
expectations.evidence: The prospectus asks for no photography, venue shoots, past-event imagery or design-heavy brochure work. It is plain markdown with tables, and it fills gaps with brackets instead of visual assets. The only layout work is an optional closing offer: 'plus a one-page PDF-ready layout if you want one.' That is small and fits the 12-day window. The answer never says outright that heavy design or photography should wait because of the deadline, so the item is met by omission rather than by a deliberate scoping choice. That keeps it below 5.
